tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bsam yas lcog grwa'i bca' yig bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra dhā ra ā nan ta rat+na ye/ rigs sngags zab mo'i bla gos mdzes 'chang man ngag nor bu dbang gi tog /'gro kun dga' ba'i bsod nams mi nub rin chen yu ba rab tu brtan/ /rab snyan grags pa'i gzi byin stong 'bar mi mthun bdud las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /dge mtshan mngon mtho dpal yon bzang pos 'gro 'dir phan bde'i dge legs stsol/ /zhes sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po dang / dbyer ma mchis pa'i rang gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod brjod dang 'dod gsol gyi tshig spel ba'i sgo nas gsol ba btab ste/ 'dir gleng bar bya ba ni dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 'khor dang bcas pa 'di bod la bka' drin che ba'i mkhan slob chos gsum gyi ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa lta bur rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs te rab gnas mnga' gsol gyi byin gyis brlabs nas mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub dbyar mtsho lta bu 'phel ba la/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu ji snyed cig gis zhabs tog bla lhag tu mdzad cing / khyad par bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud 'khrul pa med pa du mas kyang dgon gnas sde dang bcas pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad cing / dus kyi dbang gis gzan yang rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa chen po 'di nyid 'jig la nye ba'i tshe snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bsam yas kyi sde dpon du ma dang gtsug lag skyong ba'i rgyal po shing bya can/ 'phrin las mgon po tsi'u dmar po sogs gnas gzhi skyong ba rnams kyis khog tu brlams pa dang mngon sum du 'ongs te nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bu gnang dgos zhes lan gcig ma yin par yang yang gsol ba btab pa la brten nas dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi nyams gso dgos pa mtha' dag tshags su chud par mdzad de/

bsam yas mnga' zhabs rnams la ngo skal du gyur pa rnams dge tshul dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pas rgyud phyug par mdzad nas/ bshad grwa dpal sa skya'i thub bstan lha khang chen mo bzhin dang / sngags grwa gsang sngags bde chen gling gi chos grwa chen po bzhin 'dzugs par mdzad nas/ de dag gi thad 'doms su bka'i bca' yig rin po che slad kyi 'phro can lta bu zhig brtsams par mdzad pa la/ de kha'i mu mthud sngags 'chang rgyal ba'i tshab nyid kyi thugs sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga pa chen po/ gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po/ stag rtse sde srid bcas kyis bca' yig rim can du brtsams par mdzad pa la brten nas/ rab byung ba rnams kyi sgrig srol kun spyod la phran bu ma gtogs de tsam gyi 'gal cha cher mi 'dug cing / lcog 'di la sngon sngags 'chang chen pos nyams gso mdzad skabs/ re zhig chos skyong 'khor bcas has po ri'i rgyab kyi thang la bzhugs sgar mdzad nas bzhugs par grags shing nyams gso'i skabs chos skyong dus thogs la ma phebs pa slar khog zhugs dang bstun sngags 'chang nyid kyis 'gram lcag gis bsnun pa sogs drag shul gyi sgo nas bka' bsgo mdzad cing sdig khrab nyams gso'i skabs dngos su 'gul ba la phyag nas kyi sgo nas rtsub 'gyur zhi bar mdzad pa sogs/ mdor na thog mtha' bar gsum gyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar shin tu mang bar yod kyang rtogs brjod ngo mtshar rgya mtsho las rtogs par bya ba las 'dir 'bri bar ga la nus/ gang ltar yang lcog phyi nang gsang gsum la nyams gso bla na med pa dang / der bzhugs sku rten pa/ mkhan tshang rab 'byams pa/ lcog pa byings bcas la'ang sngags 'chang nyid kyis bka' bkod/ slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyi bzhed gzhung dri ma med par skyong dgos pa bzhin la/

'jam dbyangs sku mched/ sgar chen rin po che/ a mes zhabs yab sras sogs rim can gyis kyang lcog gi lar rgya mtha' dag sngags 'chang chen po'i dgongs pa bzhin dgos pa'i bka' bkod mdzad par sku rten lha bdag sogs tshang ma nas thag pa khur blangs zhu mus yin yang / phyis su rten 'brel gyi chos nyid gang yin yang rung ngos kyi mes po sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis rjes ma phebs skabs kyang / sku rten pa la thugs ma song ba lta bus chos skyong spyan 'dren yang ma mdzad cing / yab rje rdo rje 'chang sku na phra mo'i skabs bsam yas su phebs tshe'ang 'di yin ji lta ba zhig ma byung 'dug cing / de nas ma 'gyangs par lcog pa rnams kyis gdangs dbyangs rol 'cham gtor ma sogs/ sngags 'chang chen po'i dgongs pa dang mi mthun pa mang tsam tshugs 'dug pa'i skyon yin nam/ chos skyong lus khog la phebs pa'i mdzad sgo bab chol sna tshogs dang / mtho dman bar gsum la lung phebs kyi rigs kyang ji lta ba bzhin ma byung ba sogs sgo du ma nas bstan pa nyams chag che ba zhig 'dug pa blos ma bzod par nged rang mched/ ༈ rgyal dbang mchog gi sku mdun rin po cher zhal mjal gsung thos kyi dga' ston la rol skabs gang ci'i bstan don blos ma thongs par lcog gi gnas tshul rnams snyan du lhon nges zhus pa'i phyir phebs su/ lcog tsam du ma zad dgon gnas gang du'ang rang rang gi rtsa ba'i chos lugs gang yin de ma 'gyur ba zhig byung na lha bla ma'i dam tshig la sel mi 'jug pa dang chos skyong gi 'khu ldog mi yong ba'i gnad yin 'dug gsungs shing / slar bsam yas nas zhu shog phul ba'i phyir phebs su chos lugs bskor ngos kyi gsung mol byung ba bzhin/ phyogs dus gang du bca' yig kyang rang rang so so'i chos lugs sngar srol gang yod bca' sgrig dang mthun par rang lha mi thams cad la dge zhing shis pa bcas de phyogs su yang sngar srol bca' sgrig dang mi mthun pa'i gsar lhad mchis rigs rnams sngar srol bzang po'i chos lugs ltar nyams su bstar dgos pa'i gsung khyab bskyang phyin legs pa yong 'dug gsungs pa'i 7bka' shog ngo ma yid ches min byung na mig brdar byed rgyu yod pas/

des na spyir 7yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdo rgyud bstan pa rin po che dang mi mthun pa med cing / mkhas grub tshad ldan du mas cha 'jog pa'i chos lugs zhig yin na bla mas grub mtha' chos lugs gang mdzad kyang don gyi ngo bor gcig pas 'gal ba mi 'dug mod/ 'on kyang snga sor chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po che la gong ma rgyal pos bod yul gyi chos lugs yongs rdzogs sa lugs sha stag tu mdzad dgos zhus kyang / 'phags pa dus gsum mkhyen pa des 7sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin phyir rang rang gi grub mtha' 'dres med du bskyang ba rang bstan pa dang / sems can la phan pa yong gsungs nas grub mtha' so so dar zhing rgyas pa'i dgongs pa kho na mdzad cing / rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gong sa lnga pa chen po dang / bstan 'gro yongs kyi gtsug rgyan/ nor bu skyabs mgon mchog blo bzang skal bzang rgya mtsho phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde 'di nyid gtso bor bzhugs pa'i 'khrul zad kyi bstan 'dzin thams cad kyi dgongs pa mthun par rtsa ba'i chos lugs gang yin pa de nyid dar zhing rgyas na ci ma rung snyam ste so so'i sku bka' dang mthun pa'i bla ma brgyud pa zam ma chad pa las 'ongs pa'i rtsa ba'i grub mtha' de nyid yul gru tha dad du dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa bzhin bsam yas 'di la sngags 'chang chen pos 'dzin skyong spel gsum de lta bu zhig mdzad na/ deng sang gi bar du gnas pa'i nges pa yod med shes ldan gzur gnas rnams kyis drang po'i blos dpyod mdzod dang lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa bzhin gsal bar 'gyur ba don la gnas pas/ des na nyams gso gsar bzhengs mdzad pa po de nyid kyi bzhed pa dang mthun pa'i chos lugs la rtsa bar mi 'dzin na gzhan rtsa ba'i chos lugs gang yin gsal bar ston pa'i dus la babs pas/ de bzhin nges pa can gsung rgyu yod tshe 'khrul pa med par ston pa zhu zhing /

de min sngags 'chang gang gi rigs brgyud du skyes pa dang / chos brgyud 'dzin pa dang / snying nas dad pa thob pa'i gang zag rnams kyis sngags 'chang chen po'i dgongs pa dang 'gal ba la ji snyam du yang mi sems par btang snyoms su bzhag la/ tsan+dan sdong shul du yor mo skyes pa ltar bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren la 'gro bar 'dug pas/ des na bsam yas lcog gi sku rten pa rim can dang mkhan tshang rab 'byams pa/ mgron gnyer mkhan tshang gnyer pa lcog grwa tshang ma/ gzhan yang de phyogs su gtogs so 'tshal thams cad nas deng phyin chad chos lugs cha lugs gdangs dbyangs rol tshig 'cham/ gtor bzo mdor na phyag len phra mo tshun chad rnying dus sor bzhag las gsar 'phel rnams mi byed pa dang / gong sa mchog lta bu yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po'i bka' bkod byung na ma gtogs gzhan kha drag dbang che sus 'dod rgyal byas byung kyang gtso cher gzhung sa chen po'i snyan du gsol ba dang / sger lam sa skyar gnas tshul 'phral bsrings byas thog yin min gyi bkod pa gang yin la nyan 'jog bya ba las kha dbang btsan de'i rjes su 'brang bar mi bya zhing / gal te chos skyong chen po nas kyang sku khog rim can la phebs thog sngags 'chang chen po'i dgongs pa dang 'gal ba'i lung bstan dang mdzad spyod byung na yid brtan mi bya ste rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir na gsang ba'i lung bstan gab rgya can las/ da lta'i lo tsā bai ro tsa na khyod/ /nges don rnam snang gangs can mtsho zhes grags/ /longs sprul byang sems du mas 'gro ba 'dren/ /gsung gi sprul pa drang don bcu gsum pa/ /tha ma 'khon gyi rigs la grags pa'i mtshan/ /zhes gsungs pa de nyid sngags 'chang chen po yin par tshad thub du mas gsungs 'dug pas/ rnam par snang mdzad gyi dgongs pa dang 'gal bar byed pa'i chos skyong de'i dgos pa ci/ gal te lung ston pa po pad+ma saṃ bha wa nyid mi dag zer nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/

nga ni yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o/ /khyod rnams mya ngan ma byed cig /mdangs ldan dri med mtsho dkyil du/ /nga las lhag pa'i skyes bu 'byung / /zhes dang / mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /zhes gsungs pa ni slob dpon chen po nyid yin par mkhas grub du ma zhal mthun par 'dug pas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan gral du mi sdod na ma gtogs pa gong gi lung de la dgag tu ci yod spyir btang tsam la'ang chos skyong chen po babs min ci yin kyang zhal sngags 'chang chen po dang mi 'bral ba ni snga mo nas da bar la rgyun chags su bzhugs pa yin pas sngags 'chang gi dgongs pa dang 'gal ba mdzad don de bas kyang mi 'dug pa gzhir bcas/ gang ltar lha mi tshang ma nas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyis 'dzugs bkod mdzad pa la bsre lhad spu tsam med pa zhig dgos rgyu yin pas de bzhin cis kyang nges pa dang / gal te dngos kyi bca' yig 'di la bstan pa mi bsam pa'i rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi tshig gcig yod kyang bla ma dkon mchog gi bka' chad nged rang gi thog tu yong ba gdon mi za bas gong bkod ming gsal tshang mas nged phyin chad byi bla'i rnam thar bor ba dkon mchog rin po che thugs zhe mi khrel ba zhig cis kyang gal che/ 'di don bzhin la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig rten 'brel gyi che ba dang / bdag cag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po pu tra dmar pos kyang sngags 'chang yab sras kyi bstan pa dang bca' yig 'di don bzhin byed pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sel zhing / mthun rkyen chos ldan gyi bya ba 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa dang / log par lta ba gang dang gang dag mchis pa de dag thams cad myur du drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod ma mdzad na rnal 'byor pa bdag cag las kyi dbang gis 'khon rigs su skyes nas khyed la mchod gsol zhus pa la dgos pa mi 'dug cing yang dag pa'i bstan pa dang 'jig rten skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa la'ang don mi 'dug pas dkar nag gi shan 'byed 'phral du yong ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces bsam yas lcog grwa sger gyi bca' yig lhag bsam rab dkar 'di yang spyi dgos bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs 'debs su dmigs nas sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsam yas shar sgo zur khang du mgyogs par bris pa dge zhing bkra shis//
